the uptake and conversion of chlorinated benzes by barley and cress is a complex process, which is dependent on the structure of the chlorinated benzene and the plant species.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the uptake and accumulation of chlorinated benzes in plants is a dynamic process, and the bioaccumulation factors of these compounds are dependent on the species of the plants and the time of uptake.
